hero.headline: Let Pilot handle your marketing.
hero.body: Give Pilot your website and it will learn your business, your services, your products, and your brand.

whatComesNext.heading: Once Pilot knows your business
whatComesNext.body: You can generate social posts, plan your content, and manage your marketing from one place.
whatComesNext.disclaimer: Social post generation and content calendar are coming soon.

features.label: Generate social posts
features.detail: Pilot creates content that sounds like you.

features.label: Plan your content
features.detail: Build a content calendar around your business.

features.label: Manage your marketing
features.detail: One place for all your marketing activity.

connectScreen.heading: What's your business website?
connectScreen.body: Pilot will read your website and learn your business — your services, products, brand, and story.
connectScreen.disclaimer: Pilot will only read publicly available content from your website.

uploadFallback.heading: Upload Your Business Information
uploadFallback.body: If your website can't be analyzed, you can upload a document — a Word file, PDF, or text file — describing your business.

profileHeader.title: Pilot Marketing
profileHeader.sectionBody: Review the information Pilot found. Add what is missing, remove anything you do not offer, and correct any details before you confirm it as your official Business Profile.

saveBar.savedMessage: Your official Business Profile is saved.
saveBar.savedSubtext: Pilot will use only this approved information for future marketing and business answers.
saveBar.pendingMessage: Review the information above, then confirm it as your official Business Profile.
